events.description: design, manufacture, marketing, and sale of wireless e-reading device Amazon Kindle
events.source_quote: We also design, manufacture, market and sell a wireless e-reading device, the Amazon Kindle.

events.description: launch of Amazon MP3 digital music store offering DRM-free tracks
events.source_quote: In September 2007, we launched Amazon MP3, a digital music store offering DRM-free tracks from major and independent labels.

events.description: acquisition of Brilliance Audio, an independent publisher of audiobooks
events.source_quote: In May 2007, we acquired Brilliance Audio, an independent publisher of audiobooks.
In July 2007, we acquired Digital Photography Review, a website dedicated to digital photography.
In 2007, Joyo.com was rebranded to Amazon.cn to further expand our marketplace in China.

events.description: appointment of Diego Piacentini as Senior Vice President, International Retail
events.source_quote: Mr. Piacentini has served as Senior Vice President, International Retail, since January 2007.

events.description: appointment of Jeffrey A. Wilke as Senior Vice President, North America Retail
events.source_quote: Mr. Wilke has served as Senior Vice President, North America Retail, since January 2007.

events.description: appointment of Sebastian J. Gunningham as Senior Vice President, Seller Services
events.source_quote: Mr. Gunningham has served as Senior Vice President, Seller Services, since joining Amazon.com in March 2007.

events.description: appointment of Shelley L. Reynolds as Vice President, Worldwide Controller, and Principal Accounting Officer
events.source_quote: Ms. Reynolds has served as Vice President, Worldwide Controller, and Principal Accounting Officer since April 2007.

events.description: entered into a $300 million credit facility agreement
events.source_quote: In May 2007, we entered into a $300 million Credit Agreement.
